name: Mithridatium
source:
It follows the story of an alchemist living in an isolated city state on the permanently dark half of the tidally locked planet Persefona.

Follow the young alchemist as he hides from the historical and political burden both his family and the entire city carry.

In his academic retreat, he will face a patient like he has never before.

[From [url=https://city-of-sneps.itch.io/mithridatium]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
它讲述了一位炼金术士生活在一个孤立的城邦中的故事，该城邦位于被潮汐锁定的佩尔塞福纳星球的永久黑暗的一半上。

跟随这位年轻的炼金术士，了解他如何躲避他的家人和整个城市所承受的历史和政治负担。

在他的学术静修中，他将面对从未有过的病人。

[来自[url=https://city-of-sneps.itch.io/mithridatium]Itch.io[/url]]
